correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the actual P13 open-neighborhood complex from 13 six-element v+Q facets. Exhaustive fresh checker gives face vector (13,78,221,195,78,13), mod-two ranks (66,130,65), 104 missing tetrahedron boundaries all essential mod 2, three affine orbits of sizes 26/39/39, and orbitwise combined mod-two ranks 154/155/155. The ∂2 rank is exactly 66 over Q (complete K13 one-skeleton); since ∂3∂4=0 and rank_F2(∂4)=65, ∂3 rank over Q is exactly 130, so rational H2 dimension 25. A 66×66 exact triangle-boundary chord-coordinate minor has determinant +1 under the independent deterministic ordering, giving a Z-basis of the 1-cycle lattice and 155 free triangle coordinates for ker ∂2. In each distinct 39 orbit, an independently selected 155×155 matrix with 130 true ∂3 columns and 25 orbit sphere columns has exact determinant −1. Hence the boundary subgroup is primitive and H2(K;Z)=Z^25 generated by either orbit; the 26 orbit fails already over F2. A four-vertex induced subcomplex carries nonzero H2 precisely when all four triangles but no tetrahedron are present, and there can be no smaller nonzero H2 carrier. These are exhaustive computations on one finite graph, not a family theorem.
residual_risks: Independent check uses SymPy exact DomainMatrix determinant and is an explicit reproducibility check, not formal Lean or expert certification.

value.rationale: For a canonical strongly regular quadratic-residue graph, the inclusion support of H2 classes and their primitive integral generation by symmetry orbits are natural local-to-global invariants. The previously known rank 25 does not identify all shortest supports or distinguish the 26-element orbit (deficient mod 2) from two different 39-element orbits that each integrally generate. Integral unimodularity is not a routine finite-field rank corollary; the result gives an exact, reusable basis-generation certificate for a natural finite complex even without an infinite-family theorem.
residual_risks: One finite example rather than a family classification; does not give all linear relations among 104 cycles or generalization to other Paley parameters.

limitations: Exact certificate covers only one finite P13 open-neighborhood complex, not a general Paley graph family or the full automorphism group.
